shared_elements: head with headdress or head ornament above the face
bare torso with arms held at the sides/front
circular disc or medallion motif on the chest or abdomen
incised/linear surface patterning over the body
horizontal band across the waist (sash or belt)
held or clasped object near the hands
justification: Both present a frontally posed anthropomorphic figure seen from the waist up, with an ornamented head, a patterned torso bearing a prominent circular disc motif and a horizontal band at the waist, which is a real if generic correspondence. The manner of rendering is entirely different: A is a smooth, brightly painted three-dimensional figure with an asymmetric raised-arm gesture and crisp detail, while B is a blocky, heavily eroded stone monolith with shallow symmetric relief and no naturalistic modelling.
